To the Speaker of the People's Majlis, Honourable Abdul Raheem Abdulla,
After respectful greetings, I write as follows.

Regarding the matter of a new company established under the name "Maldives Port Development Private Limited"

I submit this letter requesting that Maldives Port Development Private Limited [?], and matters relating to the ownership, financing and management of that company, be sent to the People's Majlis Committee on State-Owned Enterprises (SOE Committee) for study.

Looking at the information currently available from the business registry on the website under the Ministry of Economic Development, Maldives Port Development Private Limited has been registered with the following three companies included as shareholders:

• Maldives Ports Limited (MPL);
• State Trading Organization PLC (STO); and
• Housing Development Corporation Limited (HDC).

The establishment of a separate company jointly by three state-owned companies is a matter that raises important questions relating to state finances, the principles of company management, accountability under parliamentary oversight, and doing things in a [?] visible manner. Even if there is legal authority to establish such a company under the Companies Act, these are matters that must be looked into by the People's Majlis.

In particular, I respectfully request that the People's Majlis SOE Committee investigate the following matters:

1. The legal procedures followed and the approvals given by the companies' boards in MPL, STO and HDC establishing and investing in Maldives Port Development Private Limited;
2. Whether approval has been obtained from the Privatization and Corporatization Board (PCB), the Ministry of Finance or any other office from which approval must be obtained;
3. Whether the establishment of and investment in this company is included in the [?] corporate plans of the three shareholder companies;

[stamp: People's Majlis Secretariat; 3683; Dhumani; 10:21; 1.10.26; F]
[signature] 20:21 1-10-2026

If this investigation identifies anything contrary to any law, the public finance regulations or corporate governance principles, I request that action be taken under the Majlis's [?] and that matters that need to be sent to offices such as the Auditor General and the Anti-Corruption Commission be sent to them.

The purpose of this investigation is not to make a determination about the company's legal [?] or the actions of any particular person. However, when three state companies have jointly established a company that will carry out major state projects and everything else, ensuring the reasons for choosing such an arrangement, the way state resources are used, and that a system of accountability exists is a matter connected to the public interest.

Therefore, I respectfully request that the Speaker take this into consideration and [?] have this matter looked into by the relevant committee of the Majlis.

30 September 2026

Servant of the people
[signature]
Ahmed Shakir
Member of the People's Majlis for Maavashu constituency

People's Majlis Secretariat
Malé, Maldives
